text: Wash your hands with this and do not tell anyone. Prosperity will begin to flow differently in your life. Salt is one of the oldest elements of purification that exist. It dissolves what is stagnant. Take a glass of water and add two tablespoons of salt.

Mix it well, and let it rest for one hour, so that what is dense begins to separate. Then take the glass to the sink, and wash your hands with that water, slowly. While you wash them, repeat in your mind: I release all scarcity.

I open space for prosperity. May abundance find its way to me. When you finish, rinse your hands under running water, and give thanks. Gratitude seals the work. And do not tell anyone you did this. Silence strengthens the intention.

Your hands symbolize action, my friend. When you purify your hands, you are purifying your path. Sometimes prosperity does not flow simply because it cannot find space to enter. And if you feel the blockage is not outside, but inside you, a ritual cleans the path.
What truly opens it is the inner work. Everything I know is inside The Quiet Between Thoughts. The link is in my profile.
